facts.fact: 一行人来到卢塞恩偏远边陲的恩伯斯特德村，进村的道路太窄，只能下马步行。
facts.anchor: The road into the village of Emberstead, in the remote outskirts of Lucerne, was too narrow.

facts.fact: 国王察觉村中有异样，俯身到艾莉耳边，要她跟紧自己。
facts.anchor: The king leaned closer to my ear. “Stay close. There’s something wrong with this place.”

facts.fact: 索菲说村里几个月前开始出现怪事传闻；被问多久时，她答六到八个月，可能更久。
facts.anchor: She shrugged. “Six to eight, maybe more.”

facts.fact: 格雷戈里与国王争吵：格雷戈里指责国王想用艾莉审问村民、用暗影掐人甚至烧村，国王抱臂冷冷回一句“这样更快”。
facts.anchor: The king scoffed, folding his arms across his chest. “It’s faster.”

facts.fact: 索菲提议分头行动，把格雷戈里推向艾莉，自己与国王走另一条路。
facts.anchor: “Perhaps we would be more efficient if we split up.” She pushed Gregory closer to me.

facts.fact: 格雷戈里夸艾莉善良、勇敢、美丽，流露出明显的爱慕。
facts.anchor: But I also know you are kind, courageous, brave…and beautiful.”

facts.fact: 一名村民从门道阴影中伸手抓住艾莉，用刀抵住她喉咙，把她拖进仓库；仓库里的陷阱门与假墙打开，大批持械村民涌出。
facts.anchor: Behind me, a rough hand shot out from the shadow of a doorway, yanking me backward against a hard chest.

facts.fact: 挟持者宣称不再听命于王子，同伙启动仓库中央的异光机器；他还说艾莉不属于卢塞恩，甚至不属于这个世界。
facts.anchor: “Just leave the girl with us. She’s not of Lucerne. She’s not even from this world at all.”
